description.content: The Cancel route should be used in the event the entire trip/booking (sale & purchase) require cancellation. In this case, the traveler/cardholder would be due a refund from the sale and the Virtual Card would be terminated to prevent the travel supplier from authorizing the Virtual Card.
Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2
